name: Progress M-14M
about: Progress M-14M (2012-004A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MM), launched 2012 Jan 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2012 Jan 27), held fixed
docked to A06581; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
